name: Teia Profiles Contract
description: On-chain registry of Teia profile cards, keyed by the owner's address: every wallet has at most one profile card and creates or updates it itself with set_profile. Each card stores its current IPFS/Arweave CID, a hidden flag and a version counter (version_count). The version history itself is NOT stored on-chain: every CID change emits a complete version record (tag profile_created for a new card, profile_updated for a new version, each carrying the address, CID, version number and timestamp), from which indexers reconstruct the full append-only history. The card's name, bio, avatar and display settings live off-chain in the card's CID content. set_profile charges profile_fee, which defaults to 0 and is forwarded to the fee recipient. Moderators and linked multisig users can hide (ban) any profile card and unhide it later (set_profile_hidden); the owner can still update a hidden card but cannot unhide it. Multisig governance covers pause, the linked multisig/moderator addresses, the profile fee, the fee recipient and contract metadata updates; governance proposals require a minimum number of votes and expire after a configurable time, both fetched from the linked multisig contract.
